protocol.timing: request dispatch through successful draft PR CI; provisioning excluded identically

distributionDigestMethod: sha256 of sorted relative file path UTF-8 + NUL + file bytes, concatenated for each file
limitations: This is a sequential, single-run exploratory comparison, not a statistically established general speedup.
All task CLI model calls use the same model/effort and automatic approval profile; host internal approval-model usage and unobserved launches cannot be proven complete.
Observed task tokens cover agent exit, including post-CI reporting. Wall time ends at the last successful submitted-HEAD CI completion. These windows differ.
Missing usage remains null; observed processed/fresh totals are lower bounds, not all-agent totals or billing cost.
Task reviewer Git HEAD/status/diff checks do not prove all ignored staging files were immutable; read-only instructions and observed command audit are additional bounded evidence.
The common oracle checks greeting behavior, mutation sensitivity, full fixture tests and unchanged baseline files. It is not an independent proof of every ASC policy gate.
Candidate use is explicitly requested in new-arm prompts, so this does not measure automatic route-selection frequency.
No-ASC maintains the common oracle, independent review and PR CI, but does not supply ASC planning seals, journal or policy evidence.
Host load and external provider/GitHub latency are not controlled; all outages and retries remain in wall time.
The new-fixed arm is an additional post-observation correction trial, not a replacement of the first new arm.
